limitations: No evaluator clean-build or MPI rerun was performed; documented reproduction and rank evidence were inspected only.
NACA M2 inviscid stopped at a certified 2.55-order residual plateau rather than its nominal target.
Re200 wake resolution is limited: reported St=0.1824 and mean Cd=1.2359 are modestly low and the report discloses this.
The solver and geometry abstractions are 2-D.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.
